# The Virtual Instructor

> Free and member-exclusive art instruction covering drawing, painting, and digital media with live courses and comprehensive fundamentals training.

The Virtual Instructor offers both free tutorials and premium member courses taught by Matt and other instructors. The site covers traditional mediums (drawing, watercolor, acrylic, oil, pastel) alongside digital tools like Photoshop and Procreate, with structured lesson plans for educators and community critique features.

## Key Topics

- Drawing Techniques
- Painting Techniques
- Watercolor
- Acrylic Painting
- Oil Painting
- Pastel
- Colored Pencil
- Digital Art (Photoshop, Procreate)
- Portrait Drawing
- Landscape Painting
- Still Life
- Art Fundamentals
- Line and Wash
- Mixed Media
- Beginner to Intermediate Instruction

## Core Learning Platforms

- [Homepage](https://thevirtualinstructor.com): TheVirtualInstructor.com homepage offering free art lessons by Matt and Alexia
- [Art Courses](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/members/art-courses): Member art courses including Drawing, Pastels, and Gouache instruction
- [Learn Live](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/members/learn-live): Live real-time art instruction with Matt and Ashley featuring Drawing Bootcamp
- [Explore Art Lessons](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/members/explore-art-lessons): Art lessons catalog covering Photoshop, Procreate, and multiple mediums

## Drawing Instruction

- [Drawing Lessons - Learn How to Draw](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/freedrawinglessons.html): Free drawing tutorials covering pencil, colored pencil, pen and ink, charcoal
- [Pencil Drawing Lessons](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/members/pencil-drawing-lessons): Pencil drawing courses with graphite techniques and realistic portrait methods
- [Colored Pencil Lessons](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/members/colored-pencil-lessons): Colored pencil techniques using Prismacolor, Polychromos, PanPastels materials
- [Charcoal Drawing Lessons](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/members/charcoal-drawing-lessons): Charcoal courses covering portrait, animal, and still-life drawing techniques
- [Pen and Ink Lessons](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/members/pen-and-ink-lessons): Pen and ink drawing tutorials featuring hatching and line-and-wash techniques

## Painting Instruction

- [Painting Lessons - Learn How to Paint](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/freepaintinglessons.html): Free painting tutorials covering watercolor, acrylic, oil, and gouache mediums
- [Watercolor Painting Lessons](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/members/watercolor-painting-lessons): Watercolor courses including line-and-wash and landscape painting techniques
- [Acrylic Painting Lessons](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/members/acrylic-painting-lessons): Acrylic painting courses featuring landscape, animal, and still-life subjects
- [Oil Painting Lessons](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/members/oil-painting-lessons): Oil painting courses with water-mixable oils for landscapes and portraits
- [Pastel Lessons](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/members/pastel-lessons): Pastel lessons covering soft and oil pastels for landscapes and animal portraits

## Advanced & Specialized Instruction

- [Digital Art Lessons](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/members/digital-art-lessons): Digital art tutorials for Photoshop, Procreate, and virtual reality drawing
- [Mixed Media Lessons](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/members/mixed-media-lessons): Mixed media courses combining watercolor, acrylic, colored pencils, markers
- [Art Fundamentals](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/members/art-fundamentals): Art fundamentals covering Elements of Art, Design Principles, Color Theory

## Educational Resources & Community

- [Art Lesson Plans](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/members/visual-art-lesson-plans): Visual arts curriculum and lesson plans for secondary-level art education
- [The Community at The Virtual Instructor](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/community-at-the-virtual-instructor.html): Community forums and member critique platform for online art instruction
- [The Members Minute Preview](https://thevirtualinstructor.com/members/the-members-minute-preview): Members-only episode series featuring art critique and artist feedback
